subject: Private Offer — phased acceptance, ledger top-up & invoice lane
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nebulaai.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nebulaai.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + top-up questions for private offer

Sofia,

Thanks for the earlier call. We're ready to move forward on the renewal but need a tailored private offer that supports a phased go-live across regions. A few constraints from our side:

- We'd like an initial activation in us-east (standard) and a second tranche for GovCloud (us-gov-west). Can the private offer support a two-tranche activation tied to acceptance evidence?
- Billing: we prefer staggered invoices aligned with activation (first invoice on acceptance 1, second invoice 60 days later for GovCloud).
- Ledger/top-up: we'll do an initial prepayment for base capacity and a follow-on top-up once GovCloud activation is confirmed; we'd like a ledger line item that maps to separate invoices.
- Security: GovCloud requires KMS key integration and the SOC2 evidence window to be included in the acceptance checklist.

I've attached the signed PO stub (placeholder) so you can see the internal req id. Can you confirm timeline for DocuSign and any legal pointers on term change (we may move from 12 to 18 months if pricing stays within expectation)?

Appreciate a short bullet reply so I can bring the details to procurement.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
CFO, Nebula AI
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nebulaai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal + top-up questions for private offer

Hi Alex — thanks, and really glad to hear you're ready to proceed. High-level answers and next steps below:

- Two-tranche activation: yes — we can structure the private offer with two invoice/activation tranches ("Base" and "GovCloud Top-up") tied to acceptance evidence windows. We'll include explicit acceptance criteria per region in the acceptance-checklist.xlsx (attached).
- Billing cadence: staggered invoices are fine. Our billing team will emit invoice 1 on confirmed acceptance of us-east and invoice 2 60 days later or on GovCloud activation, whichever you prefer. Please confirm the exact offset.
- Ledger line items: we'll surface separate SKU/ledger lines for Base and GovCloud Top-up so your finance team can map to separate GL codes.
- KMS / SOC2: KMS integration and SOC2 artifacts will be included as part of the GovCloud acceptance packet. We'll note any additional evidence windows required for the auditors.
- Term change: we can accommodate 18 months; pricing will be adjusted for the extended term. I'll copy legal & finance internally to validate language and invoice timing.

Attachments: RW-private-offer-draft-v2.docx (draft private offer), acceptance-checklist.xlsx (initial).

Next steps:
1) Kimberly will propose a tranche and pricing structure and share a DocuSign timeline.
2) Ben will confirm ledger line format and invoice cadence options.
3) I will update the private-offer draft to reflect GovCloud KMS notes and acceptance criteria.

If that works, can Procurement confirm whether invoice 2 should be "on activation" or on a fixed 60-day schedule?

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Proposal for Nebula private offer tranche structure

Team — drafted a recommended approach after reviewing Alex's ask:

Recommendation (high level):
- Create a two-tranche private offer: Tranche A (Base capacity) and Tranche B (GovCloud Top-up).
- Tranche A: immediate activation on signing, invoice emitted on Acceptance A (standard us-east).
- Tranche B: conditional activation — Redwood will reserve GovCloud capacity for 90 days; activation occurs once acceptance evidence for GovCloud is uploaded and validated. Invoice B can be either "on activation" or on a fixed date (60 days after invoice A) — prefer on-activation to align costs to usage but open to fixed schedule if Procurement needs predictability.
- Term: offer both 12- and 18-month term-pricing. 18 months should include a 5% effective discount vs 12-mo list for Nebula's uplift (subject to legal).
- Ledger: finance to supply GL-friendly SKU naming (Ben). We'll add explicit 'ledger_topup' SKU in the offer.

Open asks:
- Ben: confirm invoice splitting and whether we can emit two separate invoices tied to the two SKUs within a single DocuSign envelope.
- Marissa: please confirm cadence for customer kickoff and whether we want a technical onboarding PO (SOW) attached to the private offer for GovCloud work.

I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and a HubSpot note (deal RW-NEB-2027-05). I'm linking to the draft private offer in Drive and the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — K.

—Kimberly
Director, Marketplace Sales
